cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(storage_cache_followthrough C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
enable_testing()
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set(CMASTERY_STORAGE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../storage" CACHE PATH "Explicit learner storage provider directory")
if(NOT EXISTS "${CMASTERY_STORAGE_ROOT}/include/store.h")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Supply the completed storage provider using CMASTERY_STORAGE_ROOT")
endif()
set(SC_SOURCE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cache.c")
set(SC_STORE "${CMASTERY_STORAGE_ROOT}/src/store.c")
if(CMASTERY_ASSESSOR_ROOT)
 if(EXISTS "${CMASTERY_ASSESSOR_ROOT}/storage/store.c")
  set(SC_ASSESSOR "${CMASTERY_ASSESSOR_ROOT}")
 else()
  get_filename_component(SC_ASSESSOR "${CMASTERY_ASSESSOR_ROOT}" DIRECTORY)
 endif()
 set(SC_STORE "${SC_ASSESSOR}/storage/store.c")
 if(NOT CMASTERY_SC_LEARNER)
  set(SC_SOURCE "${SC_ASSESSOR}/storage_followthrough/cache/cache.c")
 endif()
endif()
function(sc_target name store_source)
 add_executable(${name} tests.c "${SC_SOURCE}" "${store_source}")
 target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}" "${CMASTERY_STORAGE_ROOT}/include")
 target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
 if(CMASTERY_SANITIZE)
  target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-pie)
  target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -no-pie)
 endif()
endfunction()
sc_target(storage-cache "${SC_STORE}")
foreach(case direct two_way identities failure commit checkpoint stale reused workload)
 add_test(NAME storage_followthrough.${case} COMMAND storage-cache ${case})
endforeach()
if(CMASTERY_ASSESSOR_ROOT AND NOT CMASTERY_SC_LEARNER)
 set(SC_CONTROLS direct identities identities failure two_way checkpoint commit stale)
 foreach(i RANGE 1 8)
  set(source "${SC_STORE}")
  if(i GREATER 5)
   set(source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/store-mutant-${i}.c")
   add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${source}" COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/mutate_store.py" --input "${SC_STORE}" --output "${source}" --which ${i} DEPENDS "${SC_STORE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/mutate_store.py" VERBATIM)
  endif()
  sc_target(storage-cache-mutant-${i} "${source}")
  target_compile_definitions(storage-cache-mutant-${i} PRIVATE SC_MUTANT=${i})
  math(EXPR index "${i}-1")
  list(GET SC_CONTROLS ${index} case)
  add_test(NAME storage_followthrough.mutation.${case}.${i} COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/expect_failure.py" $<TARGET_FILE:storage-cache-mutant-${i}> ${case})
 endforeach()
 add_test(NAME storage_followthrough.comparison.commit_only COMMAND storage-cache-mutant-6 stale)
 add_test(NAME storage_followthrough.comparison.checkpoint_only COMMAND storage-cache-mutant-7 stale)
 add_test(NAME storage_followthrough.counterexample.stale_contained COMMAND storage-cache-mutant-8 contained)
endif()
